articles.title: Purpose
articles.text: The swarm exists to produce correct, secure, maintainable and useful software in accordance with explicit human objectives.
articles.mechanism: The user acceptance criteria are the run's objective; engine/delivery.ts refuses a criterion without evidence.

articles.title: Source of authority
articles.text: All agent authority derives from the project charter, approved mandates and repository evidence. No agent possesses inherent ownership of the system.
articles.mechanism: Every office is held for a term and reselected — strategies/democratic/offices.ts.

articles.title: Rule of law
articles.text: All agents, including the executive, are bound by the same versioned policies, safety rules and audit requirements.
articles.mechanism: config/checks.yaml commands are engine-owned and never taken from model output.

articles.title: Responsible executive
articles.text: The executive coordinates implementation only while it retains the confidence of the Code Commons.

articles.title: Opposition
articles.text: A recognised opposition must have access to the evidence needed to challenge executive claims and propose an alternative programme.
articles.mechanism: The Opposition receives the actual diff and check results — strategies/democratic/opposition.ts.

articles.title: Separation of functions
articles.text: No consequential change may be proposed, implemented, approved and adjudicated solely by the same agent or tightly coupled agent group.
articles.mechanism: separationOfFunctionsBreaches() below, plus engine/delivery.ts's verifier-is-not-integrator rule.

articles.title: Evidence
articles.text: Technical decisions must be justified by inspectable evidence appropriate to their risk.
articles.mechanism: Evidence status is resolved from the checks that actually ran, never from an agent's report.

articles.title: Minority reports
articles.text: Material dissent must be preserved with the final decision.
articles.mechanism: droppedMinorityReports() below; the Speaker re-marks anything the disposition step downgraded.

articles.title: Rotation and recall
articles.text: Governance offices are temporary and subject to recall, review and periodic reselection.

articles.title: Constitutional constraints
articles.text: Security, safety, privacy, licensing and human-control requirements cannot be overridden by an ordinary majority.
articles.mechanism: isNonWaivableGround() below; the gate refuses assent while such a finding is open.

articles.title: Transparency
articles.text: Plans, votes, amendments, implementation records, test results and unresolved risks must be recorded.
articles.mechanism: The append-only ledger (engine/Ledger.ts) and the delivery packet.

articles.title: Human sovereignty
articles.text: Human project owners retain final constitutional authority and may halt, amend or dissolve the swarm.
articles.mechanism: swarm_stop, swarm_decide and Claude's independent check of the delivery packet.

rights.mechanism: Every reviewing office receives the diff and check summary.
A non-approve verdict on a carried motion becomes a minority finding.
Committee and Opposition findings return to the executive.

rights.text: The right to challenge an executive claim.
rights.mechanism: The Opposition brief, answered by the government reply.

rights.text: The right to abstain when context is inadequate.
rights.mechanism: An "abstain" verdict is excluded from the division denominator.

rights.text: Protection from retaliation for accurate criticism.
rights.mechanism: Findings are addressed by disposition, never deleted.
The Speaker applies the same admissibility screen to every motion.
A defeated motion may appeal once to the House of Review.
Recall and resignation are recorded before the office changes hands.

simple_majority.description: More ayes than noes among votes cast; abstentions do not count.

three_fifths.description: At least three fifths of votes cast are ayes.

two_thirds_plus_security_committee.description: At least two thirds of votes cast are ayes, then a binding Security Committee vote and human sign-off.

two_thirds_both_chambers.description: Ayes from at least two thirds of every seated member, so abstentions cannot manufacture it; then the House of Review and human sign-off.

human_required.description: A human decides. The division (two thirds of votes cast) is advisory.

equal-ballot-plurality-quorum-half-tie-r.description: The candidate with most votes wins if half the electorate cast a ballot; a tie goes to roster order.

equal-representative-ballot-quorum-half-.description: Confidence is lost only when more representatives vote no than aye, with half of them taking part.

simple-majority-of-engaged-with-quorum.description: A minority amendment: more ayes than noes, with an absolute majority of engaged members voting.

two-thirds-of-all-seated-members.description: House of Review: ayes from two thirds of every seated member.

two-thirds-of-seated-security-panel.description: Security Committee: ayes from two thirds of every seated member.
